description: Read the actual changes in a commit or a branch range. Pass `sha` for one commit against its first parent, or `base`+`head` for everything head adds since the merge base (what a PR proposes). Returns {files:[{path, oldPath?, status, additions, deletions, binary, patch, patchTruncated}], stats, truncated}. Patch text is byte-capped; set include_patch=false for a files-changed summary only.

max_patch_bytes.description: Total budget for patch text across all files (default 400000, max 2000000)

sha.description: Commit SHA — diffs it against its first parent

name: gluecron_get_diff
